authority: Owner approved public Private Chamber participants and final-turn movement in the FINAL 2026-10-13 packet, then authorized scoped capsule implementation in issue #139. Shared-schema and combined release adoption remain subject to affected-role review.

decisions.decision: The active Hack actor and fixed target are public during declaration, result and conversation. A pending request remains private until the ordinary turn closes. Declared-side claims, claim status and conversation content remain participant-private.

Keep declaration up to 15000ms, full private result 5000ms and full conversation 60000ms, at committed authoritative transitions. Capsule walk-in fits inside result; exit is nonblocking, returning art to latest authoritative placement. No animation acknowledgment or extra timed phase.

Capsule is cinematic scenery only, with no new gameplay location, occupant, target, capacity, movement charge or immunity. Public art is independent of private claims, role, truthfulness or microphone activity. In-person V1 adds no voice/chat/recording service.

Recover current pair, stage and remaining server deadline without replaying historical art or restarting a clock. End or superseding stages clear the live session and participant feedback; retain historical private server receipts/journal semantics.

Under FINAL G-09 voluntary movement remains open during every current ordinary turn, including the final one, until its deadline or accepted Pass. During intervening Hack stages it stays open only if a later non-Eliminated seat still has an ordinary turn. Injured/Jailed later seats count. Captain election/voting does not open this window. Keep existing health, detention, origin, quota, destination/capacity and time checks. Round 5 Code eligibility stays independent.

Preserve existing role-independent Hack eligibility, limits, declaration bluff permissions, missing declaration behavior and authorized-view practice bots. Public pair disclosure never verifies a claim or changes Scan.

contract_proposal: New-tuple-only required nullable hackSession {hackId,actorSeatId,targetSeatId} on public/player snapshots. Existing phase supplies exact current stage and timing. Existing hackFeedback remains participant-only and bound to session, current phase and round. No shared slot field in this slice.
version_policy: Provisional implementation for review, not combined release adoption. No creation default, runtime profile or art pairing is enabled. Only a separately reviewed future new-match release may select this tuple. Exact historical 1.0.1 through 1.5 projections, creation/deal pins, receipts and journals remain supported without migration. Stable slots/full Hospital and other FINAL mechanics are separate prerequisites, not claimed implemented here.
